verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents bulk export/import of user data and log streaming export (auth0-docs-46, auth0-docs-66, auth0-docs-12), showing some data portability, but there is no explicit claim of exporting *all* tenant/user data in standardized open formats, and community commentary notes 'strong vendor lock-in' (auth0-comm-15) as a caveat. missing for 10: explicit open-format (e.g., JSON/CSV standard) full-tenant export guarantee, independent confirmation that a customer successfully exported and migrated away, and no evidence of a comprehensive one-click 'leave with all data' feature.
